C1.conceptName: Rotational Dynamics and Moment of Inertia Fundamentals

evidence.text: In rotational motion, moment of inertia measures rotational resistance.
For a point mass at radius r, inertia I equals m times r squared.
Rotational kinetic energy is one half I omega squared.
Torque tau equals moment of inertia times angular acceleration alpha.
Angular momentum L equals I times omega and is conserved.

In-order traversal of a binary search tree visits keys in ascending sorted sequence.
